name: ha-cards
description: Animated Home Assistant dashboard cards (aircon, heating, awning, dishwasher, washer, dryer, hood) — dev tooling only, the cards themselves have no build step

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('cards')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'cards/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
